Each turn you're dealt 2 pronouns (ich, du, wir …). Verbs go on the field: one per turn, for free. A field verb casts once per turn (from act 2: a second time for +1 ⚡) and stays 3 turns (3 slots).

B1 – 🔧 modal verbs (können, müssen …) go in position 2 and send the verb to the end: Ich muss den Bericht schreiben. 🔗 Connectors (weil, dass, wenn, obwohl) add a second clause with the verb at the very end: Ich arbeite, weil ich Geld brauche.

🔥 Streaks: perfect sentences in a row grow stronger (×1.5 → ×1.6 → … ×2). New combos (a pronoun + verb you haven't used this fight) give +2. On the first turn you may place 2 verbs; a verb you can't place can be ♻️ recycled once per turn.
The verb decides the spell: ⚔️ attack, 🛡️ shield or ❤️ heal. The number is its power.
Word order: the verb is always in position 2. Start with a time word (heute) and the subject moves behind the verb: Heute sehe ich …
Incantation: when you forge, pick the right verb form and articles. Perfect sentences are ×1.5 stronger.
⏪ Perfekt (from A2): put it at the end to cast in the past tense – Ich habe den Hund gesehen.

💪 Strong forms: irregular verb forms (du siehst, er läuft, gesehen) and Dativ objects give +2 power. 📖 Fehlerheft: every mistake is saved – practise them at the camp to heal.

Exactly! “wenn” = if / whenever. “wann” only asks about time: Wann kommst du?
